sentiment.summary: Congressional selling pressure (3 sales, largest $50-100K) combined with market fear (42 fear/greed score) and bearish AAII sentiment (40%) suggests cautious positioning; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (333), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent FOMC decision create severely adverse macro conditions for equities despite distant earnings event.
